clips.title: The story
paras: In Camp Narache, young tauren gather Bristleback Belts to prove their valor. The belts come from quilboar in Brambleblade Ravine and mark a step in the Rite of Strength.

The Red Cloud tribe tests youths who seek respect in Thunder Bluff through the ancient Rites of the Earthmother. The first trial, the Rite of Strength, asks each initiate to protect the tribe from threats. Bristleback quilboar raid food supplies and ambush hunting parties outside Camp Narache. Chief Hawkwind demands their belts in return. Bringing him twelve proves an initiate can face danger and help defend the tribe.

Bristleback warriors and shamans in Brambleblade Ravine wear belts made from rough hide, twine, and scrap. A tauren warrior has little use for one as apparel, but its quilboar make marks it as evidence of a slain enemy. Bringing the belts back to the camp circle fulfills the rite's proof.
